## Shared scenes

> After preparing a lavish tea for the new minister, Mr. Allan, and his wife, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serve their guests at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste Anne's special layer cake, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) immediately demands to know what [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put in it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P36](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) beautifully decorates the tea table for Mr. and Mrs. Allan's visit, and even [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) is persuaded to join them. However, when Mrs. Allan tries Anne's cake, they discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored it with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P52](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0052)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. Friends and neighbors gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share their deep grief together. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues processing her sorrow with Mrs. Allan and sits with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who speaks of her upcoming eye exam and past romance with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P19](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, getting into trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church and pumping water over [Dora](../character/dora.md) after coaxing her into a pigpen. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to gently guide [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) while removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

> As the school year ends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the graveyard with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), discussing his mother's memory, his life with his grandmother, and their imaginative worlds. At the graveyard, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves flowers for [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) before walking home with Mrs. Allan, who offers encouraging advice about teaching, ideals, and friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P33](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0033)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), who has just given birth to her baby boy, little [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). Joined by Mrs. Allan, they talk about motherhood and childhood memories, which leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feeling lonely and disconnected as she walks home alone.
>
